issues.quote: **Removes:** the overnight wait for a first contact on inquiries, if Q22 clears.
issues.concern: v2 added R11: no first text outside 8 am to 9 pm customer local time. So a lead submitted at 11 pm still waits overnight. At best it gets a text at 8 am, and A5 allows it to be marked 'not texted (outside window)' instead. That leaves a gain of BDC open minus 8 am for those leads, which could be minutes. Step 0 only really removes the overnight wait for inquiries that arrive between BDC close and 9 pm. We do not know that share, and Q15 does not ask for it. This is the only days-removed claim on the page, and it now overstates what the page itself allows.
issues.because: R11 and A5 in v2; Q15 (counts by type, not by arrival hour); Q22; fact 3
issues.ask: Restate as: 'Removes: a same-evening first text for inquiries arriving between BDC close and 9 pm local; later leads get a text at window open, ahead of the BDC by (BDC open minus 8 am), if Q22 clears.' Add to Q15 the after-hours lead count split by arrival before or after 9 pm, plus the BDC open and close times. Also state in A5 which one happens at window start, the text or 'not texted', because that decides whether post-9 pm leads gain anything.

issues.quote: | R10 | The CSM reconciles forwarded leads against STL tasks (noTask apart) and checks non-inquiry texts daily in week one, then weekly while step 0 runs; follow-up rows are checked daily throughout | P0 | [PM] [E41] |
issues.concern: Step 0 is a 'configuration only' pilot, but it runs on open-ended manual work. The CSM checks follow-up rows daily 'throughout', reconciles weekly, and reconfirms the dealer pause weekly. Ops sets opt-outs by hand each morning, and the BDC manager keys every Ava appointment. Nothing says when step 0 ends or what decides keep, widen or stop. Without an exit, a one-rooftop config pilot turns into a permanent hand-run service, and we cannot copy that to a second store.
issues.because: R4, R10, section 8 'CSM reconfirms the pause weekly in month one', section 10 Watch; base-versus-one-off lens
issues.ask: Add a step 0 review at week 4, owned by the PM, with keep, stop or widen criteria taken from the section 3 measures: 0 non-inquiry texts, 0 chase sends, noTask 0, and first contact ahead of the BDC. After N clean weeks, end the daily follow-up check or turn it into an alert. State the CSM and ops hours step 0 costs per week so it can be weighed against the BDC hours (Q15).
